caption text: Figure 2. Each method's reading of Australia on the common 2021 to 2023 data, as run and under lines (a), (b) and (c) of section 5.11, beside the model's widened ranges (million people, log scale). Every reading is one dot: 19 readings of five methods on each line, including the footprint's pasture-only readings (Table 5 column (e) prints those at Australia's own productivity, 53.9 to 77.9; as run they are 316.9 and 385.7). The commodity-balance row runs 12 to 128 because grain with feed grain (127 to 128) is plotted but never binds, so the commodity balance's capacity range is 12 to 41. Line (a) keeps the productivity basis as part of the method, line (b) treats it as an input, and line (c) adds one per-person requirement and waste treatment to line (b) (cell c1 of Table S7). The grey band is the corrected release's 5th to 95th percentile (31.1 to 49.2) and the hatched band the improved release's (37.9 to 60.0); the vertical lines mark each release's base value. Built from `harmonised_comparison_lines.csv`, `harmonised_line_c.csv`, `results/ranges_2025-fixed_wide.csv` and `results/ranges_2025-improved_wide.csv`.
message: As run, every aggregate method reads well above the model's ranges, and the footprint and HALF come down toward them only when productivity is counted as an input (line b).
